phase: 4/4 - serve + bench + report (all Must-have v1 complete, measured)
stack: Python 3.12, numpy/scipy, scikit-learn, h5py/pymatreader (.mat HDF5), matplotlib, FastAPI+uvicorn, pytest; CPU-only, no API keys

dataset.name: O'Doherty et al. 2017 NHP reaching (Zenodo 583331, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.583331)
dataset.note: dataset gitignored; scripts/download_data.sh fetches + md5-verifies on demand

tests: 34 passed (pytest), including the real O'Doherty loader test

bullets_filled.kalman_vs_baseline: Wiener/ridge (0.692) edged the single-bin Kalman (0.640) open-loop; reported honestly, not tuned

measurement_methodology.decode_accuracy: per-axis Pearson CC + R2 + RMSE between decoded and true cursor velocity on the held-out later 25% of the session (leakage-safe temporal split, no shuffle across time), 64ms bins
measurement_methodology.chance_control: re-decode held-out bins after circularly shifting the firing-rate matrix by half its length (breaks neural<->movement correspondence, preserves per-unit firing stats) -> CC ~= 0, R2 negative
measurement_methodology.kalman: Wu 2006 velocity Kalman: state [px,py,vx,vy], linear-Gaussian obs of binned firing rates, closed-form ML fit on train, predict/update recursion; Q diagonal-loaded (1e-3 x mean var) for a well-conditioned 164-unit innovation covariance
measurement_methodology.task_success: OFFLINE open-loop proxy: integrate decoded velocity from true reach-start position; success = closest approach to target within radius (25% of median reach distance). NOT a live closed loop. True-velocity upper bound = 100% validates the proxy
measurement_methodology.bitrate: Shannon/Fitts: sum log2(distance/radius + 1) over successful reaches / held-out time (offline estimate, not live-BCI)
measurement_methodology.latency: wall-clock per-bin Kalman predict+update (decode compute only, excludes HTTP), p50/p95/p99 over all held-out bins, swept across 32/50/64/100 ms bin sizes; single-thread Python/numpy on Apple Silicon
measurement_methodology.serve: FastAPI stateful /decode streams one bin of spike counts -> velocity; replay harness reproduces the batch decode exactly (max abs diff 0.0)

unmeasured.cpp_hot_path_latency: ___ (Should-have v2, not built; latency is single-thread Python/numpy)
unmeasured.closed_loop_control: not applicable (offline decode; task success/bitrate are open-loop proxies)
